This week, on the sidelines of #COP29, Pradeep Kurukulasuriya and I had the pleasure of meeting with Gloria Magombo, Permanent Secretary of the Ministry of Energy & Power Development, Zimbabwe, along with other ministry dignitaries. 🫱🏽‍🫲🏼

Our discussions focused on exploring financing mechanisms for scaling off-grid minigrids across 10 identified sites and strategies to accelerate renewable energy deployment in underserved areas. We reviewed the bankability of five sites with completed feasibility studies and outlined next steps for securing funding and implementation.

We emphasized leveraging United Nations Capital Development Fund (UNCDF) and UNDP  ‘s  expertises, funding, and ongoing support in Zimbabwe’s energy sector, particularly through the Energy Offer project, which focuses on advancing sustainable, off-grid solutions for rural communities. This initiative is designed to accelerate access to sustainable, affordable energy and drive innovative financing for a green economy. 💡


These collaborative efforts are crucial for bridging energy access gaps and aligning with Zimbabwe’s goal of a 33% reduction in greenhouse gas emissions by 2030.
